correctness.rationale: A positive dissipative energy form proves the relative three-variable drift is Hurwitz. Closed second-moment equations yield the displayed rational current; full symbolic Lyapunov residual is identically zero, independently sampled covariance equations agree in 340 tests. Current is strictly increasing in F_r(p), whose logarithm is strictly concave. Direct exact polynomial differentiation and two symbolic resultants establish the unique optimizer and global sharp extremal displacement sqrt(7)/28 at precisely two reciprocal mass ratios. Quantifiers cover all m1,m2,k,G>0 and T1>T2>0, 0<p<1. Finite checks are corroboration, not substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: A fixed total thermal-contact damping resource is a natural device-design constraint, and arbitrary unequal masses are structurally different from known equal damping/onsite-pinned cases. A fully explicit all-positive-ratio optimal-contact law independent of spring and budget, together with an attained global exact small-asymmetry ceiling and equality characterization, gives a parameter-uniform design guarantee not supplied by a routine thermal-current calculation. The all-parameter sharp constant requires nontrivial elimination and global uniqueness arguments.
